title: Bizarre AI Short Film | "It’s La Vida Loca" - Kelly Boesch | 4K
description:
It’s La Vida Loca. It’s getting closer to Halloween and my characters are getting a little stranger lol. I animated these #Midjourney images using #VEO3. I am so impressed with it. The movements are wonderful as is the quality. I absolutely love doing dancing videos and trying to match the dancing with the music the best I can. It’s like a challenge. This one is just weird and fun. These make me happy when I make them. The song was made using @suno  

#ai #aiart #aivideo #aimusic #suno #aiimages #googleveoveo3
